verdict.rationale: Poly has no documented export or account-exit feature. Its own desktop app does expose your files as a real folder in Finder or Explorer that downloads on demand (poly-docs-23). Journal entries are stored as plain Markdown files (poly-docs-12), and Finder tags sync bidirectionally (poly-docs-8), so files and some metadata can be pulled out in standard formats. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, export of derived data (memory/second brain, indexes, version history) in open formats, account-deletion or offboarding guidance, and independent confirmation that a complete exit works.
